x.Description: elec_acpc_fr.elecpos x: ACPC position after CT-MRI fusion, with brain-shift compensation of the LPG/LTG grids (projection to the cortical hull, dykstra2012). These are the positions the authors stored in data.elec.

x_acpc_f.Description: elec_acpc_f.elecpos x: ACPC position as localised in the fused CT (before brain-shift compensation).

x_mni_frv.Description: elec_mni_frv.elecpos x: authors' volume-based normalisation to MNI space (FieldTrip ft_electroderealign method mni, SPM12 nonlinear). The exact MNI template variant is not stated in the release.

x_fsavg_frs.Description: elec_fsavg_frs.elecpos x: authors' surface-based registration to FreeSurfer fsaverage (grid electrodes only; n/a for depths).

SpatialReference: https://zenodo.org/records/1201560/files/SubjectUCI29_MR_acpc.nii (the authors' ACPC-aligned pre-implant T1 MRI; not redistributed in this package)
